sources.title: nllb 200 distilled 600M (未知) | Deploy Guide & Hardware Fit | OpenModelMap
sources.snippet: NLLB-200 Distilled 600M is a lightweight multilingual translation model launched by Meta, supporting high-quality machine translation for 200 languages. It significantly reduces model size and inference latency via distillation while maintaining accuracy, making it ideal for mobile and resource-constrained environments.
